title: Advance Economic Indicators Report (advance goods trade, retail & wholesale inventories, Nov 2026 data)
source: EST: census.gov/economic-indicators/calendar-listview.html lists 'Advance Economic Indicators Report (International Trade, Retail, & Wholesale) | December 28, 2026 | 8:30 AM | November 2026', id A202612280830 (fetched direct 2026-09-05). Primary-sourced, but filed estimate per the event-research lane's no-self-confirm limit on an event discovered in-sweep — and the series carries its own precedent for non-publication: the same page still reads 'Suspended' against the January and February 2026 reference months. Checked 2026-09-05
notes: The gap in an already-tracked series whose only other entry is advance-economic-indicators-2026-10-28, filed the same week. It earns its own row on an argument the 10-28 entry could not make: this is THE Census series that was actually suspended in 2026 (two reference months, per the source line above), and it lands 5 days after durable-goods-2026-12-23 and 17 days after the CR expires on 2026-12-11 — on the SAME November-2026 reference month. That makes it the corroborating observation for whether a funding lapse bit the Census release calendar, against a print whose own series has only ever been delayed. The 10-28 entry's measured finding transfers and is not re-derived here: the July-data edition on 2026-08-27 moved GDPNow's equipment contribution 0.48 -> 1.06pp, net exports -0.14 -> -1.31pp and inventories 1.71 -> 2.10pp in one release, so this report front-runs the composition question a GDP advance is read for — but the Q4 advance estimate does not print until late January 2027, so that channel is long-dated here rather than next-day. Not a tradeable print on its own (symbols: [], no house playbook is macro-keyed). CONSIDERED AND DECLINED alongside this one, so their absence reads as a decision: New Residential Sales 2026-12-23 10:00 (A202612231000), a same-day Census release with no tracked-name housing exposure; Preliminary U.S. Imports for Consumption of Steel Products 2026-12-22, suspended twice in 2026 and market-irrelevant; and the full M3 report for this reference month, which the release grid lists as TBD and which therefore has no date to file. Discovered during the durable-goods-2026-12-23 initial research (2026-09-05).
